instruction: PART 1: Match the following words with their definitions.

items.questionText: Cautious
items.correctAnswer: careful about avoiding danger or risk

items.questionText: Release
items.correctAnswer: to stop holding someone or something, to let go of

items.questionText: Approach
items.correctAnswer: to move closer to or become nearer to something or someone

items.questionText: Investigate
items.correctAnswer: to try to find out the facts about something (such as a crime or an accident) in order to learn how it happened, who did it, etc.

items.questionText: Insecure
items.correctAnswer: not confident about yourself or your ability to do things well, nervous and uncomfortable

items.questionText: Remains
items.correctAnswer: the parts of something that are left over when the other parts are gone or used up

items.questionText: Recovery
items.correctAnswer: the act or process of returning to a normal state after a period of difficulty

items.questionText: Dissatisfaction
items.correctAnswer: a feeling of unhappiness or disapproval

items.questionText: Inherit
items.correctAnswer: to receive something from someone who had it previously, especially an older family member

items.questionText: Enquire
Express
items.correctAnswer: to make your thoughts and feelings known
